about: John Ramsey is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff, Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff, Civil Litigation: Plaintiff and Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff.

John Ramsey, who practices law in Houston, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Houston Law Center. He graduated in 2000. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2000.
